limitations: Real Android/iOS upgrade, native Secure Storage and native SQLite plugin were not executed; desktop SQLite FFI and mocked Secure Storage were used.
Sources with divergent UUID data/states, incompatible identity, corruption or active lock are preserved and blocked for review.
Only the approved two HTTPS hostnames share storage; other URLs intentionally remain separate.
No backend full regression was rerun for this mobile-only change; hashes, live local images, previous data and real affected HTTP flow were verified.
